name: CIFAR-10
description: CIFAR-10 is a dataset of 60,000 32x32 color images divided into 10 classes, with 50,000 training images and 10,000 validation images. The paper introduces fast training methods (airbench94, airbench95, airbench96) that achieve 94%, 95%, and 96% accuracy respectively on CIFAR-10 in significantly reduced training time on a single NVIDIA A100 GPU.
creator: Alex Krizhevsky, Vinod Nair, Geoffrey Hinton
rai:dataUseCases: Training, Testing, Validation. The paper develops training methods to accelerate research and reduce experimental costs. The methods can be used for rapid hyperparameter tuning, projects requiring massive numbers of trained networks (e.g., data attribution studies, training variance studies), and general CIFAR-10 research requiring fast iteration times.
